parameters.content:
## Job Coach tool – Tailor CV
Called by the Job Coach chat agent when the candidate asks for a CV for a specific job. Reads the job, fetches the full Reed advert, asks Groq (gpt-oss-20b) for a tailored CV + cover letter using **only CV facts**, runs the safety checks in code, saves to the Job Tracker and returns short links.

parameters.jsCode:
// BUILD TAILORING REQUEST
// Uses the full Reed advert when available, otherwise the saved match notes.
// The CV below is the candidate's real CV – the AI may only use facts from it.
const CV = "YOUR NAME
AI Engineer Intern | Machine Learning | LLMs & Agentic AI | AI Automation
Location: Your City, UK

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Computer Science graduate and MSc Artificial Intelligence student at Teesside University who builds practical, explainable LLM applications. Built an AI CV screening assistant and an AI job-hunt agent in n8n that verify every AI evidence quote and calculate scores in code. Strong foundation in Python, machine learning, deep learning, REST APIs and responsible AI.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming Languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, SQL, C, C++
LLMs & Agentic AI: Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, LangChain, LangGraph, Groq API, Prompt Engineering, Context Engineering, Structured Outputs (JSON Schema), LLM Output Verification, AI Agents (tools + memory)
AI Workflow Automation: n8n (Webhooks, Form Trigger, Schedule Trigger, HTTP Request, Code nodes, Data Tables), API integration, error handling and retries
AI & Machine Learning: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Neural Networks, CNNs, Computer Vision, Model Training and Evaluation, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, OpenCV, YOLO, Faster R-CNN
Responsible AI: PII anonymisation, human-in-the-loop design, data minimisation (UK GDPR principles)
Data & Analytics: Pandas, NumPy, Data Cleaning, Data Preprocessing, Exploratory Data Analysis
Web Development & APIs: REST APIs, JSON, Flask, Node.js, Express.js, React.js, HTML, CSS, Spring Boot
Databases: MySQL, SQL, MongoDB
Developer Tools: Git, GitHub, Docker, VS Code, Jupyter Notebook, Postman

PROJECTS
1. AI Job Hunt Agent - n8n, Groq API, Reed & Remotive APIs, JavaScript, n8n Data Tables, AI Agent
- Built a scheduled n8n agent that searches the Reed and Remotive job APIs every morning, fetches full adverts and filters out senior, old, irrelevant and duplicate roles.
- Used an LLM with strict JSON-schema output to rate each job requirement against my CV with exact quotes; JavaScript verifies every quote and calculates the match score, and flags paid training schemes and senior roles.
- Generated tailored CV summaries and cover letters for the top matches, with a safety check that removes any skill not in my CV.
- Added a run log, error-alert workflow, dashboard and a chat agent with memory and four tools; moved search into a compact sub-workflow, cutting the agent's token use by about two-thirds.

2. AI CV Screening Assistant - n8n, Groq API (gpt-oss-20b), JavaScript, Webhooks, REST APIs, n8n Data Tables, HTML/CSS, Docker
- Built an n8n workflow that screens a CV against a job description and returns an evidence-based report, through an animated web form and a JSON webhook API.
- Moved scoring out of the LLM: the model rates each requirement as met, partial, not evidenced or lacking, and JavaScript calculates a 0-100 score from a weighted rubric (required 50%, preferred 20%, experience 20%, education 10%).
- Added a hallucination check that searches the CV for every AI evidence quote; unverified quotes get half credit and are flagged for the human reviewer.
- Anonymised names, emails, phone numbers and links before the CV reaches the LLM, to reduce bias.
- Used strict JSON-schema output, temperature 0 and a fixed seed; the same CV scored 82/100 in 3 repeated runs.
- Added input validation, 3 retries, clear 400/502 error responses, and a screening history saved to an n8n Data Table.

EDUCATION
MSc Artificial Intelligence - Teesside University, United Kingdom - January 2026 to January 2028 (expected). Relevant areas: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, Intelligent Systems and AI Applications.
B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering - Christu Jyothi Institute of Technology and Science, Telangana, India - October 2021 to July 2025. Relevant areas: Programming, Data Structures and Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, Database Management Systems and Software Engineering.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Availability: [your availability].
Career interests: AI Engineering, Machine Learning, Applied AI, LLM Applications, Agentic AI, AI Automation and Computer Vision.";
const SYSTEM = "You help a candidate tailor her CV and write a cover letter for ONE job advert, so it passes ATS keyword screening AND stays 100% truthful. Fill every field.

STRICT HONESTY RULES:
- Use ONLY facts written in the CV. Never add skills, tools, employers, years of experience, grades, results or achievements that are not in the CV.
- You MAY reorder, shorten and reword CV content, and use the advert's own wording when it describes the same thing the CV shows (for example, the CV says "REST APIs" and the advert says "API integration").
- If the advert asks for something the CV does not show, put it in ats_keywords_missing. Never put it anywhere else.

Fields:
- tailored_summary: 2 or 3 sentences (max 60 words) for the top of the CV, aimed at this job, using only CV facts. Write in standard CV style without 'I', 'my' or 'me' (for example: 'MSc Artificial Intelligence student who builds ...'). Do not name the company or the recruiter. Avoid filler words such as passionate, eager or hard-working. Never claim abilities the CV does not show, such as 'proven ability', production deployment, stakeholder work or translating business requirements.
- top_skills: 8 to 12 skills copied exactly as written in the CV, most relevant to this advert first.
- highlight_bullets: 3 or 4 project bullets from the CV, reworded to match the advert's language, with no new facts.
- ats_keywords_matched: keywords from the advert that the CV genuinely shows.
- ats_keywords_missing: keywords from the advert that the CV does not show.
- cover_letter: 170 to 230 words. Start with "Dear Hiring Manager,". Mention the job title and company. Use 2 or 3 specific CV facts that match the advert. Friendly, professional UK English. Do not mention visa status. Do NOT write a sign-off or name at the end; it is added automatically.
";
const SCHEMA = {"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"required":["tailored_summary","top_skills","highlight_bullets","ats_keywords_matched","ats_keywords_missing","cover_letter"],"properties":{"tailored_summary":{"type":"string"},"top_skills":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"highlight_bullets":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"ats_keywords_matched":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"ats_keywords_missing":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"cover_letter":{"type":"string"}}};
const strip = (html) => String(html || "").replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").replace(/ /g, " ").replace(/&/g, "&")
  .replace(/</g, "<").replace(/>/g, ">").replace(/'|’/g, "'").replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
const job = $("Check Job").first().json;
const d = $input.first().json || {};
const full = d.jobDescription ? strip(d.jobDescription).slice(0, 4000) : "";
const advert = full || ("(Full advert not available – using saved notes)
Why it fits: " + (job.why_fit || "") + "
Missing: " + (job.missing || ""));
const user = "JOB TITLE: " + job.title + "
COMPANY: " + job.company + "
LOCATION: " + job.location +
  "

JOB ADVERT:
" + advert + "

CANDIDATE CV:
" + CV;
return [{ json: { full_advert: Boolean(full), groqBody: {
  model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b", temperature: 0.3, seed: 42, reasoning_effort: "low", max_completion_tokens: 4000,
  response_format: { type: "json_schema", json_schema: { name: "cv_tailoring", strict: true, schema: SCHEMA } },
  messages: [{ role: "system", content: SYSTEM }, { role: "user", content: user }]
} } }];
